page.overview:
What is Studios?

Studios is a theme that was introduced in 2000 and discontinued by the end of 2002.

Sets of the theme mainly focused on the making of stop-motion movies and the steps and practices thereof. The theme featured several licensed subthemes, including Jurassic Park III and Spider-Man in 2002.

The appeal of Studios is that the stop-motion animation camera, included with the set 1349 LEGO & Steven Spielberg MovieMaker Set, allows users to create real stop-motion movies with LEGO Bricks. In response, many websites that are dedicated to creating such movies, which are now known as "Brickfilms", have been created. The largest sets of the Scary Monster and Spider-Man subthemes include the LEGO Studios SoundFx software, which contains audio and video clips that can be imported into the original MovieMaker software.

Several minifigures from other themes appear as actors. This includes the Adventurers characters Johnny Thunder, Pippin Reed, and Mike who appear as actors in 1355 Temple of Gloom, 1354 Dino Head Attack, 1370 Raptor Rumble Studio, and 4064 Actor 2.
